split: NUAA-SIRST/train, all tests held untouched; engineering diagnostics on already-trained sources
scope: Training-panel results. CE and image interventions are independent restarts; old logs validate training statistics, not archived intermediate weights.
grad_convention: Unscaled gradient of each full objective on its first four-image group; None means disconnected. Loss terms are weighted; FP16 backprop can cause deviation from float vector sums.

original_unchanged_loss_repeatability.objective: full original S2 combined; first four original samples; same seed, original registered scale 512 and clip 2
